name: com.tidyuse/calculators
title: TidyUse Home & Garden Calculators
description: Free home, garden & DIY calculators (concrete, paint, mulch, roof, tile, stairs) — US & metric.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: List or search all free TidyUse home, garden, DIY calculators and printable tools with their MCP tool names and web URLs.

tools.name: calculate_concrete
tools.description: Calculate concrete volume (cubic yards, cubic feet, m³) and whole 80 lb, 60 lb, and 40 lb bag counts for rectangular slabs or round post holes.

unit.description: "us" uses feet for length/width and inches for thickness/diameter/depth; "metric" uses meters for length/width/depth and cm for thickness/diameter.

kind.description: "slab" for rectangular slab/footing, "round" for cylindrical post holes or piers.

length.description: Slab length (ft in us, m in metric). Required when kind="slab".

width.description: Slab width (ft in us, m in metric). Required when kind="slab".

thickness.description: Slab thickness (in in us, cm in metric). Default 4 in / 10 cm.

diameter.description: Hole diameter (in in us, cm in metric). Required when kind="round".

depth.description: Hole depth (in in us, m in metric). Required when kind="round".

count.description: Number of identical slabs or holes (1-1000).

bagSize.description: Primary QUIKRETE bag size in lb ("80", "60", or "40").

tools.name: calculate_paint
tools.description: Estimate interior/exterior wall paint in US gallons, liters, and whole cans from room dimensions or total wall area, subtracting doors and windows.

length.description: Room length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width+height OR area.

width.description: Room width (ft in us, m in metric).

height.description: Wall height (ft in us, m in metric). Default 8 ft / 2.4 m.

area.description: Known total wall area (ft² in us, m² in metric) instead of room dimensions.

doors.description: Number of standard doors (21 ft² / 1.95 m² each) to subtract.

windows.description: Number of standard windows (15 ft² / 1.39 m² each) to subtract.

coverage.description: Coverage per container unit (ft²/gallon in us, default 350; m²/liter in metric, default 10).

canSize.description: Container size (US gallons in us, default 1; liters in metric, default 2.5).

tools.name: calculate_mulch
tools.description: Calculate mulch volume in cubic yards, cubic feet, liters, and whole bags across one or more garden areas.

length.description: Area length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR area.

width.description: Area width (ft in us, m in metric).

area.description: Known total garden area (ft² in us, m² in metric).

depth.description: Mulch depth (in in us, default 3; cm in metric, default 7.5).

bagSize.description: Bag size (ft³ in us, default 2; liters in metric, default 50).

tools.name: calculate_raised_bed_soil
tools.description: Calculate soil volume in cubic feet, cubic yards, liters, and whole bags for one or more rectangular raised garden beds.

length.description: Bed length (ft in us, m in metric).

width.description: Bed width (ft in us, m in metric).

depth.description: Soil fill depth (in in us, default 12; cm in metric, default 30).

bagSize.description: Bag size (ft³ in us, default 2; liters in metric, default 50).

tools.name: calculate_gravel
tools.description: Calculate gravel volume (cubic yards, m³), weight (US short tons, metric tonnes, lb), and bags for driveways, patios, and paths.

length.description: Area length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR area.

width.description: Area width (ft in us, m in metric).

area.description: Known area (ft² in us, m² in metric).

depth.description: Gravel depth (in in us, default 3; cm in metric, default 7.5).

bagSize.description: Bag volume (ft³ in us, default 0.5; liters in metric, default 20).

tools.name: calculate_roof_pitch
tools.description: Convert between rise/run, roof pitch per 12 (x:12), slope percentage, and angle in degrees.

rise.description: Vertical rise (any consistent length unit). Used when mode="riseRun".

run.description: Horizontal run (same unit as rise, > 0). Used when mode="riseRun".

pitchPer12.description: Rise per 12 units of run (e.g. 6 for 6:12). Used when mode="pitch".

angleDegrees.description: Roof angle in degrees (0 to <90). Used when mode="angle".

tools.name: calculate_roofing
tools.description: Calculate true sloped roof surface area, roofing squares (100 ft²), and shingle bundles from building footprint, pitch, overhang, and waste.

length.description: Building footprint length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR footprintArea.

width.description: Building footprint width (ft in us, m in metric).

footprintArea.description: Known horizontal footprint area (ft² in us, m² in metric).

overhang.description: Eave/rake overhang on each side (ft in us, m in metric). Default 0.

bundlesPerSquare.description: Shingle bundles per 100 ft² square (1-6). Default 3.

tools.name: calculate_tile
tools.description: Calculate floor, wall, or backsplash tile counts and whole boxes including grout joint width and waste percentage.

length.description: Surface length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR area.

width.description: Surface width (ft in us, m in metric).

area.description: Known surface area (ft² in us, m² in metric).

tileLength.description: Tile length (in in us, cm in metric). Default 12.

tileWidth.description: Tile width (in in us, cm in metric). Default 12.

groutJoint.description: Grout joint width (in in us, default 0.125; mm in metric, default 3).

tools.name: calculate_flooring
tools.description: Calculate laminate, vinyl plank, or hardwood flooring boxes, optional underlayment rolls, and total material cost.

length.description: Room length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR area.

width.description: Room width (ft in us, m in metric).

area.description: Known room area (ft² in us, m² in metric).

boxCoverage.description: Coverage per box (ft² in us, default 20; m² in metric, default 2).

underlayRollCoverage.description: Optional underlayment roll area (ft² or m²; 0 to skip).

pricePerBox.description: Optional price per box (0 to skip).

tools.name: calculate_drywall
tools.description: Calculate drywall sheets needed for walls, walls + ceiling, or a known surface area across 4×8, 4×10, 4×12 ft and metric sheets.

kind.description: "walls" for walls only, "room" for walls + ceiling, "area" for known area.

length.description: Room length (ft in us, m in metric).

width.description: Room width (ft in us, m in metric).

height.description: Wall height (ft in us, default 8; m in metric, default 2.4).

area.description: Known surface area (ft² in us, m² in metric) when kind="area".

openingsArea.description: Total door/window area to subtract (ft² in us, m² in metric).

tools.name: calculate_deck
tools.description: Calculate deck board rows, total linear feet/meters, boards to buy, and deck screw count.

lengthAlongBoards.description: Deck dimension parallel to the boards (ft in us, m in metric).

widthAcrossBoards.description: Deck dimension across the boards (ft in us, m in metric).

boardWidth.description: Actual board width (in in us, default 5.5; mm in metric, default 140).

gap.description: Gap between boards (in in us, default 0.125; mm in metric, default 3).

boardLength.description: Length of each purchased board (ft in us, default 16; m in metric, default 4.8).

joistSpacing.description: On-center joist spacing (in in us, default 16; mm in metric, default 400).

tools.name: calculate_fence
tools.description: Calculate fence posts, panels or pickets, rails, and 80/60/40 lb post-hole concrete bags.

length.description: Total fence run length (ft in us, m in metric).

postSpacing.description: Post spacing (ft in us, default 8; m in metric, default 2.4).

gateWidth.description: Width per gate (ft in us, default 4; m in metric, default 1.2).

picketWidth.description: Picket width (in in us, default 5.5; cm in metric, default 14).

picketGap.description: Gap between pickets (in in us, cm in metric).

tools.name: calculate_stair
tools.description: Calculate staircase risers, exact riser height (to nearest 1/16 in), treads, total run, stringer length, angle, and IRC code check.

totalRise.description: Total vertical rise floor-to-floor (in in us, cm in metric).

maxRiser.description: Max riser height (in in us, default 7.75; cm in metric, default 19.7).

treadDepth.description: Tread depth (in in us, default 10; cm in metric, default 25.4).

tools.name: calculate_square_footage
tools.description: Calculate area for a rectangle, L-shape, circle, or triangle in ft², m², yd², and acres, plus optional unit cost.

length.description: Length for rect or first part of lshape (ft in us, m in metric).

width.description: Width for rect or first part of lshape.

pricePerUnitArea.description: Optional price per ft² (us) or per m² (metric).

tools.name: calculate_wallpaper
tools.description: Calculate whole wallpaper rolls by vertical drops (not square feet) for US double rolls or European rolls with straight or half-drop pattern repeats.

length.description: Room length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR wallWidth.

width.description: Room width (ft in us, m in metric).

wallWidth.description: Total wall width to paper (ft in us, m in metric), e.g. for an accent wall.

height.description: Wall height (ft in us, default 8; m in metric, default 2.4).

rollPreset.description: Roll preset: us205 (20.5 in × 33 ft), us27 (27 in × 27 ft), euro (53 cm × 10 m).

repeat.description: Pattern repeat length (in in us, cm in metric) when match is straight or half.

tools.name: calculate_paver
tools.description: Calculate patio or walkway pavers, whole packs/pallets, and spare pieces from dimensions or known area.

length.description: Patio length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR area.

width.description: Patio width (ft in us, m in metric).

area.description: Known patio area (ft² in us, m² in metric).

paverLength.description: Single paver length (in in us, default 8; cm in metric, default 20).

paverWidth.description: Single paver width (in in us, default 4; cm in metric, default 10).

paversPerPack.description: Pavers per pack or pallet (default 1 for single pieces).

tools.name: calculate_grass_seed
tools.description: Calculate grass seed weight (lb and kg) and whole bags for a new lawn using OSU Extension species presets or a custom seeding rate.

length.description: Lawn length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR area.

width.description: Lawn width (ft in us, m in metric).

area.description: Known lawn area (ft² in us, m² in metric).

species.description: Species preset: tf (Tall fescue), kbg (Kentucky bluegrass), ff (Fine fescues), pr (Perennial ryegrass).

customRateLbPer1000Ft2.description: Optional custom seeding rate in lb per 1,000 ft² (overrides species preset).

bagWeight.description: Bag weight (lb in us, default 7; kg in metric, default 5).

tools.name: calculate_curtain
tools.description: Calculate curtain panel counts, pairs at desired fullness (1.5×–2.5×), and recommended ready-made drop length.

width.description: Window frame width or rod width (in in us, cm in metric).

rodExtensionEachSide.description: Extension past each side of window when kind="window" (in in us, default 4; cm in metric, default 10).

panelWidth.description: Single flat panel width (in in us, default 50; cm in metric, default 135).

rodHeight.description: Optional rod height above floor for drop length (in in us, cm in metric; 0 to skip).
